# ONSITE

> ONSITE is an antiscalant manufacturer in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Brand: CLEAN RO (products CLEAN RO and CLEAN RO-1) — phosphonate-based antiscalants for reverse osmosis and nanofiltration membranes. Production capacity: 40 tonnes per month. Free dosing calculation from feed water analysis; TDS and SDS available for every product; delivery across Uzbekistan, payment in UZS.

## Products
- [CLEAN RO and CLEAN RO-1](https://onsite.uz/en/antiscalant-clean-ro.html): phosphonate-based antiscalants for reverse osmosis and nanofiltration.

## Service
- [Dosing calculation and technical support](https://onsite.uz/en/dosing-service.html): free dose calculation, start-up, monitoring, membrane cleaning recommendations.

## Industries
- [Industries](https://onsite.uz/en/industries.html): mining and metallurgy, food and beverage, automotive, construction and buildings, power and boiler houses.

## Case studies
- [Case studies](https://onsite.uz/en/projects-cases.html): АО «НГМК», ГМЗ-3, SamAvto, Refresh Water.

## About
- [About ONSITE](https://onsite.uz/en/about.html): technical expertise by Sherozbek Dalimov, 8 years at Nalco Water (An Ecolab Company).
